description: Parcel-Specific Open Data Descriptions: Commercial Buildings Energy Consumption Survey and Florida Building Code is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Karen Angeles, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). The rulesets provided herein document open data descriptions available in the Department of Energy's Commercial Buildings Energy Consumption Survey and the Florida Building Code. The rulesets can be utilized to develop computational workflows that support automated building characterizations for parcel-specific loss estimations. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-tewe-2m61. Keywords: open data; ruleset; hurricane; building characterization. Published 2022-01-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
